{{Quote|Been a long hunt, but I found the vermin's nest. It's on an old dirt ball of a planet called "Ruhnuk."|[[Mandalore the Avenger]]|<ref name="TOR:DD" />}}
During the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian civil war]] between the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]] and the renegade [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] faction known as the [[Hidden Chain]], [[Mandalore the Avenger]] undertook a '''mission''' to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to track down [[Heta Kol]], the Hidden Chain leader. Although she failed to capture [[Gauss]], the Hidden Chain recruiter she was hunting since her previous [[Mission to Mek-Sha (Mandalore the Avenger)|mission to Mek-Sha]], Mandalore was able to place a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]] on [[Rubassa]] of [[Clan Ha'rangir]]. She was eventually able to track the Hidden Chain to its main base: [[Ruhnuk]].<ref name="Snare" />
